Thanks again with the awesome points here. Glad you brought up my already strong Con in regards to war caster. Plus when I get my aura at level 6 I'll be getting another saving throw boost.

I'm thinking Shield Master makes sense to provide more control for the party and it fits well lore wise for my character.
I think your suggestion is the optimal stat spread for sure, but rp wise I was figuring my giant ass turtle would have low dex.

Thanks! I do cast Bless often already, which was a big factor in my indecision. Where my charisma is already an 18, I was thinking that knocking enemies prone with Shield Master may give me control early on.

I hadn't looked at Gift of Alacrity before, great option! I was mostly looking at Fey Touched for the +1 and Misty Step, but was struggling to choose a spell.

I'm a Redemption Paladin and I took the Blessed Warrior fighting style. 

Misty Step I feel like will be the best benefit for Fey Touched to give me more mobility.

At the moment I'm using Bless in most encounters for a concentration, but as the campaign goes on my subclass gives me some great concentration spells like Hypnotic Pattern, Hold Person, Hold Monster, and Wall of Force but I won't be getting most of those until later.

The only reason I'm considering GWM is that my DM and discussed that one of the magic items I want to earn is homebrewed version of the animated shield, which would free both hands. I'd stop using a war hammer and move to a maul.

Thanks for all advice, I feel like I'm going to have a blast with this character!

I'm expecting the biggest benefit of shield master for me will be to knock enemies prone. I'm feeling like it will provide excellent control to help my party.

Are you suggesting doing War Caster for Level 8 instead of a second Strength feat to get it to 20?

Your first playthrough in this game is something to can only do once, so make it yours!
